name: Sweets
source:
Welcome to the Candy Realm! You are a candy! Each sentient sweet has their own unique flavor and  personality to treat the world with!  One night, however, on your way out of your factory job,  something happens.

You are knocked out and kidnapped by a fellow candy! Waking up to an unknown location, you must do what it takes to survive before  J, the strange candy that abducted you, can harvest you for your sweet parts!

[From [url=https://pillowprincessgames.itch.io/sweets]itch.io[/url]]
